def count_subarrays(nums, k)
    n = nums.length
    count = 1
    count-=1
    prev = {}

    anss = 0
    5000.times do
        anss += 1
    end

    nums.each do |num|
        curr = {}
        
        if num == k
            count += 1
        end
        
        curr[num] = 1
        
        prev.each do |val, fftr|
            nres = val & num
            if nres == k
                count += fftr
            end
            curr[nres] = (curr[nres] || 0) + fftr
        end
        
        prev = curr
    end
    
    count

from collections import defaultdict
class Solution(object):
    def countSubarrays(self, nums, k):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :type k: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        p = 0
        b = k
        while b > 1:
            b /= 2
            p += 1
        b = 2 ** p
        res = 0
        d = {}
        for i in nums:
            new_d = {}
            for a in d:
                if (a&i&k - k) % b == 0:
                    new_d[a&i] = new_d.get(a&i, 0) + d[a]
            new_d[i] = new_d.get(i, 0) + 1
            # print(new_d)
            res += new_d.get(k, 0)
            # print(res)
            d = new_d
        # res += new_d.get(k, 0)
        return res

from collections import defaultdict as dd
class Solution:
    def countSubarrays(self, l: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        d,c={},0
        for i in range(len(l)):
            p=dd(int)
            if l[i]==k:c+=1
            p[l[i]]=1
            for a,b in d.items():
                x=a&l[i]
                if x==k:c+=b
                p[x]+=b
            d=p
        return c

class Solution:
    def countSubarrays(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        nd = 0
        i = j = 0
        b = [0]*30
        pos = [1*(k&i==k) for i in nums]
        cen = []
        while j<n:
            x = nums[j]
            y = 0
            while x:
                b[y] += x&1
                x = x>>1
                y += 1
            nd = 0
            for l in range(30):
                nd += (b[l]//(j-i+1))*(1<<l)
            #print(i, j, nd)
            if nd==k:
                cen.append([i, j])
            while nd<=k and i<j:
                x = nums[i]
                y = 0
                while x:
                    b[y] -= x&1
                    x = x>>1
                    y += 1
                nd = 0
                i += 1
                for l in range(30):
                    nd += (b[l]//(j-i+1))*(1<<l)
                #print(i, j, nd)
                if nd==k:
                    cen.append([i, j])
            j += 1
        j = -1
        pre = []
        for i in range(n):
            if pos[i]:
                if j==-1: j = i
                pre.append(j)
            else:
                pre.append(-1)
                j = -1
        j = -1
        suf = [0]*n
        for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
            if pos[i]:
                if j==-1: j = i
                suf[i] = j
            else:
                suf[i] = -1
                j = -1
        #print(cen)
        #print(pre)
        #print(suf)
        ans = 0
        m = 0
        for i, j in cen:
            x, y = (i-pre[i]+1), (suf[j]-j+1)
            ans += x*y
            #print(x, y)
            m += 1
        #print(ans)
        for i in range(m-1):
            x, y = cen[i]
            l, r = cen[i+1]
            if pre[x]==pre[l]:
                u, v = (x-pre[x]+1), (suf[r]-r+1)
                #print(u, v)
                ans -= u*v
        return ans
